name: Swami Sivananda
dates_notes: Born 1887 and died 1963; dates and publications are recorded by the Divine Life Society.

dates_evidence.description: Divine Life Society publication and biographical records.

core_thesis: Swami Sivananda was a twentieth-century author and teacher whose Divine Life Society published a large body of Yoga and Vedānta literature. His relevance here is not an unsupported claim that he founded a new Vedānta school, but his extensive written exposition of the Bhagavad-Gītā, Brahma-Sūtras, principal Upaniṣads, self-knowledge, and Vedānta for modern readers. The entry keeps his modern synthesis distinct from the classical commentarial traditions and records only catalogue-verified authorship until local, rights-cleared editions are acquired for passage-level work.

engaged_works.title: The Principal Upanishads
engaged_works.ascription_notes: The Divine Life Society identifies the volume as by Swami Sivananda and describes text, meaning, notes, and commentary on nine principal Upaniṣads.
engaged_works.summary: An English volume of text, meaning, notes, and commentary on principal Upaniṣads. It establishes a substantial Vedānta-commentarial corpus, but this repository does not yet hold an edition that supports local quotation or Sanskrit alignment.
